mainText: <speak><voice name="Justin">Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 79 degrees under clear skies at the Verona Public Library. We are also under a full moon tonight.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Joanna">The City of Verona is looking for your help with the I Voted sticker contest. Verona students submitted 53 designs, and now community members can vote for their favorites in four grade-level categories through August 7. You can cast your vote online or in person at City Hall during absentee voting hours.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Kendra">We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the lineup includes the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company, and trivia at The Bogey Factory.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Kimberly">Looking at the weekly report, officers were dispatched to a residence on Lucerne Drive on July 23 for a domestic disturbance, which led to a 23-year-old man being arrested for disorderly conduct and intimidation of a victim.</voice></speak>
<speak><voice name="Matthew">The flavor of the day is Caramel Pecan. The shop is open until 11 PM, so you still have plenty of time to head over and enjoy a scoop or two.</voice></speak>
